start: Tollhouse roof is caving in—wade the gravel shallows under bow cover and grab Fenwick's tax box before the floor drops.
mid: Strongbox is clear of the embers! Reform on the bank; Grok'tar's horn is braying from the eastern bluff.
danger: Gnoll pack on the flank! Keep shields locked in the current or the river takes the wounded!
win: Grok'tar's down in the mud and the Thornwick road stays open. Tally the survivors and wring out your boots.
lose: The ford is lost and the ledger burned with the tollhouse. Fall back to Thornwick before nightfall.

start: Keep the peat smoke low and the litter level. Burn every willow nest before those barbed darts find a seam.
mid: Halfway to the stone watch-post. Bren's fever is climbing—keep scraping that green bile off their shafts.
danger: Arrows out of the mist! Form a tight ring around the stretcher—do not let them tip Bren into the bog!
win: Watch-post gate barred behind us and Bren's on a dry cot. Good work keeping the lantern out of the fen.
lose: The bog swallowed the litter and the poison finished the rest. No scout comes back from those willows.

start: Gate's twisted off its hinges. Lock shields around the bailey wellhead—we hold until grey dawn or die wet.
mid: First light's hitting the ridge! Coup de main into the pines—chop down all three bone totems feeding that witchfire.
danger: They're pouring over the inner wall! Tighten on the wellhead—don't give them an inch of cobble!
win: Last totem's kindling and the witchfire's dead. Ravenwatch still flies our rag, battered as it is.
lose: The wellhead ran red before sunrise. Ravenwatch belongs to traitors and bone-singers now.

start: Watch your footing on the slime-slick causeways. Something old is stirring under that black cloister water.
mid: Two flooded galleries cleared. Mordred's chanting louder ahead—keep a rear guard watching the silt behind us.
danger: Drowned thralls climbing out of the water behind the column! Turn spears—don't get pinched on the stones!
win: Mordred's face-down on his own blood-altar and the water's gone still. Up the stairs before the air turns.
lose: Dragged into the silt beneath Ravenwatch. Nobody down here gets a grave marker.

start: No lanterns till the summit—hack through the lower deadfall and pull Corin out from under that mail wagon.
mid: Corin's breathing and the wax seals are intact. Push up the cliff stair—the northeast beacon waits at the top.
danger: Ambushers on the switchback! Shield the courier—if those dispatches burn, the passes fall blind!
win: Tar's lit and the northeast beacon is roaring! Every watchtower from here to Thornwick can read the warning.
lose: Corin's down and the dispatches are ash in the dark. The high passes won't even know what hit them.

start: Salt pork first, accounting ledger second, black powder last—unless you fancy flying over the spruce tops.
mid: Rations are smoking and Tarn's ledger is in our satchel. Clear the blast radius before you touch a torch to the kegs.
danger: Sparks near the powder depot! Pull back from the timber wall or the whole wood goes up with us!
win: Three craters where Tarn's depots stood, and we have every thief's name inked in his own ledger.
lose: The powder went up with our company inside the trees. Tarn keeps his stolen iron—and his skin.

start: Split into two wings at the granite horn. Keep pace in both frozen gorges—neither side takes the summit alone.
mid: Stone sentinels cracking on both defiles! Push to the twin cairns and wait for the single horn blast.
danger: One wing is stalled under heavy stone blows! Break through the gorge or the other flank gets butchered!
win: Twin Cairns lit on the same breath! The alpine pass is ours from ridge to ridge.
lose: One wing broke in the ice and the sentinels ground the rest to bone-meal.

start: Drive the sharpened stakes into the mud and lock pikes across the planks. Three thousand folk are behind our backs.
mid: Half the carts are over the crest, and the second wave's hitting the timber. Hold the bridgehead!
danger: They're hacking at the stake-line! Plug the gap with steel—one broken plank and the refugees drown!
win: Last farm cart cleared the ridge and the raiders are floating downstream. Drop your pikes and catch your breath.
lose: The bridge buckled and the riders poured into the column. Alder ran red before noon.

start: Peat fog's thick enough to chew. Peel off Krag's outriders and grab that vitrified glass from the old quarry kilns.
mid: Kiln glass is packed and Krag's drums are right ahead. Aim mauls and lightning at the seams in his rune-hide!
danger: Ironhide's charging straight through our shield-line! Scatter and hit his flanks before he tramples the casters!
win: Krag Ironhide's down like a felled oak and the moorland drums have quit. That quarry is silent at last.
lose: Ironhide's maul broke our line in the fog. The clans will be marching on Thornwick by dusk.

start: Keep torches low in the dwarven galleries—foul air pools in the dips. Purge the blood-cultists from all three vents.
mid: Two galleries scrubbed clean. Check the rune-locked armory doors before we push for the southern stair.
danger: Cultists flooding out of a side shaft! Hold the archway—don't let them trap us in the dark!
win: Southern stair is clear and the wind's blowing clean through the Undervault. Ashbrook has its lifeline back.
lose: Trapped below the snow-choked passes. The Undervault becomes one more dwarven tomb.

start: Brace the splintered postern! Hold the gatehouse until the evacuation wagons roll clear on the north road.
mid: Townsfolk are clear! Now open the postern and sally out—take Commander Vaelen's head while Morvessa watches.
danger: The ram just cracked the crossbeam! Hold the breach for ten more heartbeats or the wagons are caught!
win: Vaelen's banner is in the dirt and Ashbrook's folk are safe. Let Morvessa chew on that from her ridge.
lose: The postern gave way too soon. Ashbrook burned with its people still trapped inside the walls.

start: Stay on the sunken stone causeway—step onto that pink alkali crust and it'll swallow a pack-mule whole.
mid: First bone-pit outpost is ashes. Watch the salt glare ahead; two more block the desert road.
danger: Men bogged down in soft alkali while raiders close in! Haul them out onto the flagstones now!
win: All three bone-pits burned to white ash and the Redmarsh road is open. Scrape the salt off your greaves.
lose: Swallowed by the salt pans and picked clean by bone-pit raiders. Just like the three trains before us.

start: Up the blind goat-trails—stay out of the notches until those cliffside horn-bows are silenced.
mid: Both high blinds cleared! Grab the iron audit tallies from their baskets and hit the central pass gates.
danger: Horn-bow volley raking the ledge! Hug the red granite overhang and rush the nests!
win: Central gates shattered and the audit tallies are ours. The Redmarsh escarpment is cracked wide open.
lose: Pinned on the red granite like targets on a butt. Never made it past the notches.

start: Tie rags over your eyes against the copper grit and watch for red flares—three scout squads are pinned out there.
mid: Two squads pulled clear of the sandstone rings. One flare left—push through the wind before the riders regroup.
danger: Sand-riders circling out of the dust wall! Tighten formation—don't get separated in the grit!
win: All three vanguard squads accounted for and the encirclement broken. Spit the red dust out and march.
lose: Lost sight of the flares in the copper storm. The sand-riders picked our squads off one by one.

start: Keep sand buckets full on the catwalks—clay firepots are coming up those dry creek beds with the ladders.
mid: Midnight's passed and the north palisade still stands. Smash every ladder crew before they hook the timber!
danger: Firepot burst on the south catwalk! Douse the pitch before the whole palisade catches!
win: Grey dawn over Highgate Watch and the creek beds are choked with broken ladders. Well held.
lose: The palisade went up like dry kindling and three warbands poured through the ash.

start: Cut down the coven sorcerers around those bleeding quartz spires before they split the climate-wards for good.
mid: Two circles purged—snatch their blood-stained parchment rubbings so our mages can re-attune the stone.
danger: The third spire is fracturing! Kill the ward-breaker now or the alkali storm flays us alive!
win: Black blood stopped weeping and the quartz spires hum true again. Keep those rubbings dry.
lose: The wardstones shattered and the alkali sky tore open over our heads.

start: Screen both mudbanks with spears and keep every thirsty fool away from the Bitter Well—the wagons must roll.
mid: Three axles hauled out of the muck—halfway to camp. Watch the mud for burrowing beetles!
danger: Beetles erupting under the water-cask wagon! Protect the wheels—lose those casks and the camp dies dry!
win: Six heavy wagons rolled through the camp gate with every bandage and sweet-water cask intact.
lose: Axles snapped in the mire and the forward camp's supplies sank into Redmarsh mud.

start: Breach the thorn-smoking ditch and stay upwind of those Granary Smokers unless you want to fight blind.
mid: Assay vault's cracked and the silver's bagged. Now put torches to the tarred canvas and burn their stolen grain.
danger: Wind shifted—choking smoke across the vanguard! Back out of the hollow and reform upwind!
win: Granary's a roaring furnace and the assay bullion is clinking in our packs. Let Gorrathul's troops eat cinders.
lose: Blinded in the smoke trench and butchered before we ever touched a grain sack.

start: Wet cloth over nose and mouth—Kaelen's marrow-rot fumes will sour your blood before you reach the stones.
mid: Outer censers smashed and the black fog's thinning. Push into the willow hollow and cut Kaelen down!
danger: Censers flaring green—men are coughing blood! Smash the nearest brazier right now!
win: Kaelen's dead among his broken megaliths and our wounded twenty miles back can finally breathe clean.
lose: Marrow-rot took the vanguard before we crossed the stone ring. The hollow claims more bones.

start: Take the upper ballista ledges first—nothing moves on the quarry switchbacks while those bolts fly.
mid: Ballistas silenced! Fight down to the third terrace, smash the slave-pens, and drop the chief overseer.
danger: Chain-gangs caught in crossfire on the ramp! Draw the guards clear of the ironstone pens!
win: Overseer's down the shaft and the miners are striking off their own shackles. Gorrathul's smelters go cold.
lose: Pinned on the switchbacks under ballista fire. The Deep Quarry keeps grinding bones for ironstone.

start: Forty tired blades and half-built walls—save your spells and guard the inner water cisterns from torches.
mid: Two columns blunted on the revetments! Horns on the ridge—relief is coming, just hold the cisterns!
danger: Torch-bearers broke through to the well-cover! Cut them down before they foul the water!
win: Relief column's pouring through the gate and the cisterns are clean. Forty sentinels held the lifeline.
lose: Cisterns burned and the revetments crumbled. Crossroads Redoubt is an empty shell.

start: Drop the heavy packs—light troops forward! Bring Vorn down in the gravel before Ironheart's portcullis drops.
mid: Rearguard's broken and empty waterskins mark his trail! Close the gap—the fortress gate is in sight!
danger: Vorn's nearing the portcullis chain! Loose everything you've got—do not let those blueprints inside!
win: Vorn's in the gravel and Gorrathul's fortress blueprints are rolled tight in our belt. Now we know every weak stone.
lose: The portcullis slammed shut behind Vorn's heels. Ironheart keeps its secrets.

start: Silence the eastern cliff guns first, or those two bog-flanked causeways turn into a slaughterhouse.
mid: Eastern redoubts quiet and the bridges are ours! Ram the citadel gate and take the keys off Gorrathul.
danger: Artillery bracketing the narrow causeway! Rush the gatehouse—standing still on the stones is death!
win: Gorrathul's dead and the iron keys hang from our belt. Redmarsh is broken—on to the coast!
lose: Cut to pieces on the forked causeways beneath Ironheart's guns.

start: Low water won't last—wade onto the Greywash mudflats, torch the blockade pontoons, and take the storehouses.
mid: Pontoons burning and marsh stores secured! Now storm the grounded command hulk and clear Oakhaven's channel.
danger: Tide's turning on the mudflats! Push onto the hulk's boarding planks before the water rises!
win: Channel's open and Oakhaven's harbor masters are raising our colors. Ironcamp coast has a foothold.
lose: Caught between rising tide and ironclad crossbows on the Greywash flats.

start: Wet wool over your mouths—the groundwater's boiling. Shatter the three outer ward-rings on the basalt cliffs.
mid: Outer rings cracked and the steam's easing! Rush the central vent and finish the chief fire-binder.
danger: Steam vent erupting under the line! Clear the cracked basalt before it scalds the vanguard!
win: Fire-binder's cold in the basalt and Oakhaven's wells are cooling down. Good work above the cliffs.
lose: Blistered lungs and boiled boots—the geomancers turned the cliffside into a kiln.

start: Split the column around Split Tooth—silence both arbalest redoubts before anyone climbs that granite spire.
mid: Flanking batteries are quiet! Converge on the razor ridge and storm the command tent.
danger: Crossfire pinning the east wing! Silence that battery now or the other column gets flanked!
win: Command tent taken on Split Tooth's crest and the coastal road is open again.
lose: Caught in the interlocking arbalest lanes with nowhere to hide on the razor rock.

start: Hold the bracken around the ruined chapel—sixty crippled men are inside and raider hounds are on the scent.
mid: Half the stretchers are aboard! Keep the hounds off the canvas while Sera hitches the Triage Wagon.
danger: Hounds through the bracken near the hospital tents! Fall back and form a wall in front of Sera!
win: Triage Wagon rolled over the ridge with all sixty wounded safe. Not a single stretcher left behind.
lose: The hounds got into the chapel tents. Sera didn't make the ridge.

start: Two hours till spring tide floods the lower ward chin-deep! Blow the kelp-slick water-gate and move fast.
mid: Drowned armory looted and water's at our knees! Up the lighthouse stair—slay the Castellan before we swim!
danger: Tide's surging through the lower arch! Climb the stair now or drown in full plate!
win: Castellan's down on the lighthouse landing and our packs are heavy with dry armory steel.
lose: The spring tide sealed the lower ward and took the company down with the fortress.

start: Leave the baggage in the ditch—hack through three canyon roadblocks at a dead run! Lyra has fourteen bolts left.
mid: Two roadblocks splintered and red flares are right overhead! Punch through the last barricade!
danger: Pickets shouting from the watchtower—they're out of bolts! Charge the courtyard gate!
win: Courtyard relieved with Lyra down to her last dagger! Drop the packs and pass the waterskins.
lose: One roadblock too many—Iron-Gate Watchtower fell silent before we cleared the canyon.

start: Noon's coming fast—ambush both supply mule-trains on the wooded switchbacks before they reach the chalk walls.
mid: Both convoys taken and the redoubt's cisterns are dry! Brace for the garrison's desperate sortie.
danger: Gate's flying open—starving steel charging down the slope! Hold the switchback choke!
win: Sortie broken and High-Orchard Redoubt's white rag is going up. Didn't even need a siege engine.
lose: The mule-trains slipped inside the chalk walls and the garrison's sortie swept us off the hill.

start: Take the central sluice island and hammer iron wedges into those counterweight gears before they flood the gorge!
mid: Gears wedged tight—the floodgates can't drop! Cross the spans and clear the eastern gatehouse.
danger: Enemy engineers prying at the gear wedges! Clear the sluice platform before eighty feet of river drops!
win: Eastern gatehouse secured and the black river roars harmlessly below. Solid ironwork, lads.
lose: The floodgates tripped and the torrent swept both spans clean.

start: Spread out against tectonic stomps—pour arcane fire and bodkins into the moss-grown seams of that colossus!
mid: Stone plating's cracking and its furnace core is exposed! Keep moving and hammer those glowing joints!
danger: It's raising both fists for a quake! Disperse the infantry now or lose the whole front rank!
win: The Age of Chains colossus collapsed into cold boulders. Pine ridge pass is open at last.
lose: Ground to paste beneath bedrock fists on the pine ridge.

start: Smash the main gate and lock down both flanking vaults—don't let Baron Vane lift that extortion bullion!
mid: Both vaults secured! Cut Vane off at the catacomb iron grate before he buys half the coast.
danger: Vane's guards are lowering the catacomb lift! Rush the grate before the turncoat slips underground!
win: Baron Vane's in irons at the grate and every bar of bullion stays right here in our ledger.
lose: Vane dropped down the catacomb shaft with the gold—every sellsword on the coast will hunt us tomorrow.

start: Drive a steel wedge straight between Ironclad Banner and Ashen Company before they stop brawling and look at us!
mid: Standards split in the mud! Drop both warlords before their captains cobble together a truce.
danger: Their horns are sounding a parley! Slay the warlords now before both warbands turn on our flanks!
win: Both warlords face-down in the hollow and the harbor salvage is ours without a truce to worry over.
lose: They settled their quarrel over our corpses in the mud.

start: Retake the seawall catapults while the drydocks burn—Kael's copper flagship won't go far without a rudder!
mid: Rudder's splinters! Grappling hooks out—board Kael's flagship through the pitch-smoke!
danger: Pitch-pots raining onto the seawall! Keep the catapult crews covered or the deck cooks us!
win: Flagship taken and Vesperion's mocking stopped right at the point of a blade. Harborwatch is saved.
lose: Harborwatch burned to the waterline while Kael's flagship sailed out laughing.

start: Form a tight wedge on the black glass sand—watch for yellow sulfur crust and camouflaged ash-stalkers!
mid: Halfway across the cinder flats! Push through the stalker packs and fortify Highcrest bluff before dark.
danger: Sulfur crust caving in on the left flank! Pull clear of the boiling vents and watch the ash-drifts!
win: Stakes driven into Highcrest bluff as night drops. We have solid ground in the volcanic heartland.
lose: Swallowed by boiling vents and picked apart in the cinder dark before reaching the bluff.

start: Spread wide against arcing violet lightning—slay each crag beacon-warden and smash the prisms with heavy mauls!
mid: Two prisms shattered and the static dome is flickering! Take the last crag and break the seal.
danger: Lightning chaining down the line! Break formation—do not bunch up near the crystal beacons!
win: All three prisms are glass dust and the obsidian pass lies open ahead.
lose: Arcing static cooked our armor on the crags before the dome ever flickered.

start: Tip those siege ladders off Greystone's parapet—pumice mortar won't take many more hits from those demonic engines!
mid: Glacis cleared of ladders! Open the sally port and burn all three catapults to charcoal!
danger: Siege-brutes cresting the parapet! Throw them off the wall before they open the gatehouse!
win: Three demonic catapults burning on the glacis and Greystone Bastion still stands.
lose: Greystone's curtain wall crumbled to gravel and the horde poured over the rubble.

start: Shatter Malrik's jagged obsidian walls as fast as he raises them—don't let the blind traitor reach the portal stairs!
mid: Two barriers down and shadow constructs are thinning! Malrik's cipher-keys are right ahead on the steps.
danger: Obsidian shards erupting across the gorge! Cut through the constructs before Malrik opens the portal!
win: Malrik's down on the portal stairs with the leyline codices intact in our hands.
lose: The portal snapped shut behind Malrik—and our stolen cipher-keys went with him.

start: Count twenty heartbeats between mana-cannon volleys! Sprint cover-to-cover and climb the blind scree behind both crags.
mid: One crag gun spiked! Cross the causeway dead-ground and silence the twin battery.
danger: Rune-barrels glowing bright—five heartbeats to volley! Get under the scree overhang now!
win: Both mana-cannons spiked with iron wedges and the citadel causeway is ours to cross.
lose: Caught on the open causeway when the twenty-heartbeat volley vaporized the shield-wall.

start: Lock tower-shields overhead—thirty paces of magnetic iron canyon, three spiked portcullises, and cliffside crossbows!
mid: Two gates cracked and the iron golems are scrap! Strip the cliff nests and breach the final portcullis.
danger: Crossbow bolts hammering the shield-roof while golems close in! Keep the formation locked!
win: Third portcullis down and the cliff nests cleared. Nothing left between us and the outer moat.
lose: Pinned between animated iron and cliffside bolts inside the magnetic canyon.

start: Wet hides over your backs—storm the West and Center gatehouses above the magma moat and cut those counterweight winches!
mid: Winches severed! Stand clear of the chains as the heavy iron drawbridge drops across the fire.
danger: Hides are smoking over the moat heat! Breach the gatehouse door before the embers catch!
win: Iron drawbridge thudded home across the magma. The Citadel's outer rampart is breached!
lose: Burned off the basalt ledge above the glowing moat before a single winch was cut.

start: Three relief armies on the ash plains—hit the northern column first before they pin us against the citadel wall!
mid: Northern column routed! Pivot west and blow their powder convoy before the eastern host closes.
danger: Eastern host hitting Three-Roads Watch while we're out on the plain! Wheel back and hold the camp!
win: Northern column scattered, powder convoy cratered, and the eastern host broken. The siege holds!
lose: Crushed between three relief hosts and the basalt walls of the Citadel.

start: Steady ranks in the obsidian nave—break the Arch-Warden's silent praetor phalanx before we touch either door.
mid: Phalanx is fracturing! Clear the central dais so we can weigh the stars against the fire.
danger: Praetors locking spears around the dais! Punch through their center before they box us in!
win: The Arch-Warden's guard lies silent on the obsidian floor. Now step up and choose Thornvael's threshold.
lose: Cut down in silence beneath the twin doors of the obsidian nave.

start: Hold the West and East Anchor Seals under the cracked dome—keep the shadow praetorians off the marble altar!
mid: Celestial leylines are half-aligned! Hold both seals while the pale starlight locks into place.
danger: Shadow praetorians flooding the West Seal! Reinforce that circle or the leyline snaps!
win: Leylines locked and the Crown of Order rests true upon the altar. Cold light sweeps the realm.
lose: The Anchor Seals broke and shadow swallowed the marble vault.

start: Watch the floor vents around the Obsidian Throne—shatter the West and East Conduit Pillars to weaken Ashkarath!
mid: Both Conduit Pillars down and the primordial fire's guttering! Finish Ashkarath upon the dais!
danger: Floor vents splitting wide with roaring magma! Leap clear and keep pressing the First Warden!
win: Ashkarath's broken on the Obsidian Throne and the unchained fire dies to embers. Thornvael is free.
lose: Consumed on the Obsidian Throne while First Warden Ashkarath kept the primordial flame.
